metadata.lookahead_policy: outcome candles open at or after replay timestamp; no candle data before the signal timestamp is scored
metadata.incomplete_outcome_policy: INCOMPLETE_DATA unless all 864 expected 5m candles from the signal timestamp through the 72h expiry are contiguous or TP/SL is reached before a gap
metadata.forming_candle_policy: reconstruct 1h/4h/15m in-progress candles from completed 5m bars before the boundary plus boundary 5m open only; no post-boundary OHLCV is exposed
metadata.harness_mode: scanner_v5.main historical injection; 3-way chronological chunk merge

rrce_aligned_short_research.method: RRCE cohorts are observed scanner outputs; indicator overlays are fixed hypotheses. First two chronological thirds are discovery, final third is holdout.
rrce_aligned_short_research.warning: This replay is regime-sensitive. A candidate is not approved by a positive aggregate result; independent additional holdout and economic expectancy checks remain required.

short_setup_alignment.decision: NO CANDIDATE APPROVED. The final chronological segment contains no TP3; any threshold that looks strong in discovery is regime-overfit and must not be promoted.
